div.div: فِرْزَةٌ A piece, or detached portion, (S, O, Msb, K,) of a thing that is put, or set, apart, away, or aside, or that is removed, or separated; (S, O, K;) as also ↓ فِرْزٌ : pl. [of pauc.] أَفْرَازٌ and [of mult.] فُرُوزٌ: and ↓ فِرْزٌ signifies also a portion, or share, that is put aside for the party to whom it pertains, whether one [person] or two. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
